status: new prospective programme frozen after comparative-generality v1 structural screening and before numeric vertical values are opened in either admitted source

relationship_to_v1.v1_failures_not_relabelled: Both admitted sources remain STRUCTURAL STOP under comparative-generality v1.
relationship_to_v1.new_design_reason: The closed v1 structural screen identified exactly two independent native-height sources with four repeat individuals and no vertical outcome opened. The new programme asks whether a four-individual panel can be evaluated prospectively under a separately frozen estimator.
relationship_to_v1.outcome_guidance: none; source admission uses only previously opened nonvertical structure and native-height presence

closed_source_set.vertical_semantics: source-native GPS height above reference ellipsoid
source-native GPS height above mean sea level

admission_rule: All and only independent sources in the frozen comparative-generality v1 screen that (a) have an accepted native event-level vertical field, (b) retained exactly four repeat individuals under the unchanged >=50-event and >4-h-gap session rule, and (c) have not had numeric vertical values opened are admitted.

outcome_blind_preflight.quality_filter: respect explicit source visible/outlier flags where present; never filter by height magnitude
outcome_blind_preflight.session_rule: within individual, split consecutive retained events at gap >4 hours
outcome_blind_preflight.projection: per source UTM from median nonvertical longitude/latitude

horizontal_axis.timing: must be opened and frozen before vertical magnitude for each source
horizontal_axis.self_profile: equal-weight other eligible sessions of same individual
horizontal_axis.other_profile: pool eligible sessions within each other individual then equal-weight the three other individuals
horizontal_axis.aggregation: equal target session within individual then equal individual
horizontal_axis.null: whole-session identity permutation preserving the exact session-count multiset per identity

vertical_primary.field: source-specific native vertical field frozen above
vertical_primary.session_centering: subtract full frozen eligible-session median before binning
vertical_primary.self_profile: equal-weight other frozen eligible sessions of same individual
vertical_primary.other_profile: pool eligible sessions within each other individual then equal-weight the three other individuals
vertical_primary.common_cell_weighting: derive equal-session self weights on target-supported 5-km cells and apply identical weights to self and other vertical profiles
vertical_primary.target_score: mean supported-event log P_self(centered z)-log P_other(centered z)
vertical_primary.aggregation: equal target session within individual then equal individual
vertical_primary.null: whole-session identity permutation over frozen source training universe preserving exact session-count multiset; replay support/profile/weighting pipeline

programme_reporting.primary: report both source effects regardless of sign; neither can replace the other
programme_reporting.cross_source: with only two sources, report bivariate horizontal-vs-vertical positions descriptively; no population-level prevalence or predictor test
programme_reporting.v1_status: continue to report each source as structurally ineligible under the original >=5-individual programme

prohibited: drop one source based on its vertical result
exclude an individual after vertical opening
promote this new programme as satisfying the original v1 >=5-individual gate
claim_boundary: The design change is based only on nonvertical sample structure, not on vertical effects.
A source that fails the four-individual common-support gate stops before vertical opening.
A vertical FAIL remains a prospective result under this small-panel programme.
This programme tests two specific structurally available sources and does not estimate prevalence across bats.
